welcome.title: Welcome to HealthSkin

welcome.photoError: Please add a photo to continue
welcome.privacy: Your data is private and never shared.

profile.title: Tell us about yourself
profile.subtitle: This information personalizes your experience
profile.toneHint: Helps us choose the best ingredients for you
profile.climateHint: Your environment greatly influences your skin's needs

skin.title: Your current skin
skin.subtitle: Be honest — no judgment here!
skin.hint: Think about how your skin feels 15–20 minutes after washing your face, without applying any cream or moisturizer.
skin.feelingLabel: How does your skin feel after washing?
skin.feelingHint: Wait 15–20 min after cleansing, no moisturizer, then observe.

feelings.label: Tight & dry
feelings.sub: Your skin feels tight, uncomfortable, or starts to flake. This usually means dry skin.

feelings.label: Comfortable & balanced
feelings.sub: Your skin feels just right — not dry, not oily. This usually means normal skin.

feelings.label: Shiny within 1 hour
feelings.sub: Your whole face becomes shiny and greasy within about an hour. This usually means oily skin.

feelings.label: Oily T-zone only
feelings.sub: Your forehead and nose get oily, but your cheeks stay normal or dry. This usually means combination skin.

feelings.label: Sensitive & reactive
feelings.sub: Your skin often feels irritated, red, or itchy after washing — even with gentle products.

skin.concernsHint: Select all that apply — it's normal to have several at once
skin.sensitivityHint: Does your skin react easily to products, climate changes, or stress?

sensitivities.label: Yes — I have sensitive skin
sensitivities.sub: My skin often reacts: redness, itching, burning, or breakouts from products

sensitivities.label: Sometimes
sensitivities.sub: I occasionally react to certain products or environmental changes

sensitivities.label: Rarely
sensitivities.sub: I rarely have reactions — only with very harsh products

sensitivities.label: No — my skin is resilient
sensitivities.sub: My skin tolerates most products and conditions well

goals.title: Your skin goals
goals.subtitle: What do you want to improve?
goals.hint: Choose all that apply — most people have 2 or 3 goals at the same time. There is no wrong answer.
goals.timelineHint: Natural skincare takes consistency. Be realistic — the longer your commitment, the deeper the results.

timelines.label: 2 weeks
timelines.sub: Quick wins — visible hydration & first glow

timelines.label: 1 month
timelines.sub: Noticeable improvement in texture and radiance

timelines.label: 3 months
timelines.sub: Real transformation with a consistent routine

timelines.label: Long-term (6+ months)
timelines.sub: Lasting habits for permanently healthier skin

routine.title: Your current routine
routine.subtitle: Let's see where you're starting from
routine.hint: No need to be perfect — we will build from where you are now.
routine.waterLabel: How much water do you drink per day?
routine.waterHint: Hydration is the #1 beauty supplement — it directly affects skin glow and firmness

water.label: <1L
water.sub: Less than 1 litre — quite low for skin health

water.label: 1–1.5L
water.sub: 1 to 1.5 litres — moderate, room to improve

water.label: >2L
water.sub: More than 2 litres — excellent for skin

routine.exfoliationHint: Exfoliation removes dead skin cells and helps active ingredients absorb better

exfoliation.label: Never
exfoliation.sub: I don't currently exfoliate — starting fresh

exfoliation.label: 3 or more times a week
exfoliation.sub: Frequent exfoliation — we'll monitor for over-stripping

routine.naturalLabel: Do you currently use natural skincare?
routine.naturalHint: Natural or DIY products made from plants, fruits, oils, or clays

natural.label: Yes, regularly
natural.sub: I use natural or DIY products most days

natural.label: Sometimes
natural.sub: I mix natural and conventional products

natural.label: Not yet
natural.sub: I've never tried natural skincare — I'm starting now

diet.title: Diet & hydration
diet.subtitle: What you eat and drink directly affects your skin
diet.hint: Your skin reflects your diet. This helps us suggest recipes that complement your lifestyle and improve your glow from the inside.
diet.dietLabel: How would you describe your diet?
diet.drinksHint: Select all that apply — be honest, this helps us personalize your routine
diet.allergiesLabel: Do you have any known food allergies or intolerances?
diet.allergiesHint: We will exclude those ingredients from all your recipes and routines
diet.digestionHint: Gut health and skin health are closely connected — bloating and poor digestion often show up on the skin

digestion.label: Yes
digestion.sub: Regular bloating, IBS, constipation, or digestive pain

digestion.label: No
digestion.sub: My digestion is generally comfortable and regular

safety.title: Safety check
safety.subtitle: A few important questions to keep you safe
safety.warning: This app is for wellness & educational purposes — not medical advice. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.
safety.pregnantLabel: Are you currently pregnant or breastfeeding?
safety.pregnantHint: Some natural ingredients (e.g. essential oils, high-dose herbs) may need to be avoided during pregnancy.

pregnant.label: Yes — I am pregnant or breastfeeding

safety.reactionLabel: Have you ever had a reaction to natural cosmetics?
safety.reactionHint: This helps us flag high-risk ingredients in your recipes

reactions.label: Yes — I've reacted to natural ingredients before
reactions.sub: We'll add safety flags to high-risk ingredients in your recipes

reactions.label: No — I've never had a reaction
reactions.sub: We'll still include patch-test reminders for new recipes

commitment.title: Your commitment
commitment.subtitle: Help us set the right pace for you
commitment.hint: Be realistic — a routine you can stick to every day is far more powerful than a perfect routine you abandon after 1 week.
commitment.timeLabel: How much time can you dedicate per day?
commitment.timeHint: Even 5 minutes is enough with daily consistency

time.label: 5 min / day
time.sub: Quick — one simple action per session (e.g. a smoothie or a mask rinse)

time.label: 20 min / day
time.sub: Solid routine — prep, apply, and rinse

time.label: 30+ min / day
time.sub: Full ritual — all steps with care and intention

commitment.complexityLabel: What recipe complexity do you prefer?
commitment.complexityHint: This determines how elaborate your weekly plan will be

complexity.label: Simple
complexity.sub: 2–3 ingredients max, under 5 minutes to prepare

complexity.label: Elaborate
complexity.sub: I enjoy the process — more ingredients and steps are fine

complexity.label: Mix of both
complexity.sub: Quick recipes on weekdays, more elaborate on weekends

commitment.remindersHint: We'll send gentle nudges at morning, midday, and evening to keep you on track

reminders.label: Yes, remind me
reminders.sub: Morning, midday, and evening gentle notifications

reminders.label: No thanks
reminders.sub: I'll check the app on my own
